description: Properties panel for the wireframe editor. Shows editable fields for the currently selected element(s). Supports single-select (all PropDef fields grouped by category, plus Layout X/Y/W/H and Element/ZIndex sections) and multi-select (intersection of common props, Mixed indicator when values differ). All mutations are routed through the cascaded WireframeCommandStack when available. Text and number inputs use per-field debounce (350 ms); dropdowns and checkboxes apply immediately. Changing a size prop with SizePresets defined automatically resizes the element.

parameters.name: SelectedIds
parameters.description: IDs of the currently selected elements. Empty = no selection shown.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel wrapper.

examples.title: Properties panel bound to canvas selection
examples.code:
<TmWireframeDesignerCanvas @ref="_canvas"
                           Document="_document"
                           DocumentChanged="d => _document = d"
                           OnSelectionChanged="ids => _selectedIds = ids" />

<TmWireframePropertiesPanel Document="_document"
                             DocumentChanged="d => _document = d"
                             SelectedIds="_selectedIds" />

@code {
    private WireframeDocument _document = new();
    private string[] _selectedIds = [];
}
